cards.en: Excuse me, is this your coat?
cards.cn: 打扰一下，这是你的外套吗？

cards.en: Yes, it is. Thank you very much.
No, it isn't. It's my sister's bag.
cards.cn: 不，不是。那是我姐姐的包。

cards.en: This is Miss Lee. She is from China.
cards.cn: 这是李小姐，她来自中国。

cards.en: That is Mr Brown. He is American.
cards.cn: 那是布朗先生，他是美国人。

cards.en: What colour is your new dress?
cards.cn: 你的新裙子是什么颜色的？

cards.en: My hat is grey and my shoes are brown.
cards.cn: 我的帽子是灰色的，鞋是棕色的。

cards.en: Look at them. They are tired.
The children are hungry and thirsty.
Give me the red one, please.
It's next to the living room.
The cups are on the table.
The dog is under the chair.
There is a television in the room.
There are some magazines on the shelf.
Is there a clock on the wall?
He is sitting in the garden.
The children are playing in the park.
A boy is swimming in the water.
What are you going to do?
I'm going to paint this bookcase.
cards.cn: 我打算把这个书架刷一下。

cards.en: Are you going to paint it pink?
cards.cn: 你打算把它刷成粉色吗？

cards.en: No, I'm going to paint it white.
What are you going to do with that vase?
cards.cn: 你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？

cards.en: I'm going to put it on the table.
cards.cn: 我打算把它放在桌子上。

cards.en: Is there a piece of cheese in the fridge?
Are there any letters for me?
Can you type this letter for me?
No, thanks. I'd like some tea.
Do you want any meat today?
What's the weather like in spring?
Is it cold here in winter?
Yes, I like it very much.
What do you usually do on Sundays?
Do you often go to the cinema?
Sometimes. My wife never goes with me.
cards.cn: 有时去。我妻子从不跟我一起去。

cards.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
I have some envelopes, but I haven't any writing paper.
cards.cn: 我有几个信封，但没有信纸。

cards.en: Did you enjoy yourself at the party?
cards.cn: 你在聚会上玩得开心吗？

cards.en: Yes, we enjoyed ourselves very much.
The car race was on the third of May.
cards.cn: 赛车比赛是在五月三日。

cards.en: What did you do last Sunday?
I went to the market and bought some fruit.
cards.cn: 我去了市场，买了些水果。

cards.en: Yes, I asked a policeman for help.
cards.cn: 是的，我向一位警察求助。

cards.en: These shoes are too small for me.
cards.cn: 这双鞋对我来说太小了。

cards.en: Do you have a bigger size?
I bought this shirt last month.
cards.cn: 我上个月买了这件衬衫。

cards.en: We need some bread and milk.
cards.cn: 我们需要一些面包和牛奶。

cards.en: No, we haven't. Let's buy some.
Have you ever been to Beijing?
Not yet. I've only just started.
Have you heard about the accident?
Yes, I have. It happened this morning.
cards.cn: 听说了，是今天早上发生的。

cards.en: How long have you lived here?
I've lived here for ten years.
How long has she been a teacher?
Will you be at home this evening?
Our new neighbour will move in next week.
cards.cn: 我们的新邻居下周搬进来。

cards.en: What time will the train leave?
It will leave at half past seven.
May I see your ticket, please?
cards.cn: 请让我看一下您的车票。

cards.en: Whose is this small blue case?
cards.cn: 这个蓝色的小箱子是谁的？

cards.en: Do you know where he lives?
I think he lives near the station.
He says he is very busy.
She says she will write to me.
She told me she had finished the work.
cards.cn: 她告诉我她已经完成了工作。

cards.en: It was easy. I answered all the questions.
cards.cn: 很简单，我回答了所有问题。

cards.en: I want you to carry this box.
He told me to wait here.
Please ask him to come early.
I want you to be careful.
This dress is too small for me.
cards.cn: 这条裙子对我来说太小了。

cards.en: It's smaller than the blue one.
Would you like to try it on?
Shall we go for a walk?
This is the most expensive model.
Is this the best one you have?
No, the smallest one is the cheapest.
Have you got a hundred-yuan note?
Is there anything in the box?
Somebody is knocking at the door.
What were you doing when I called?
cards.cn: 我打电话的时候你在做什么？

cards.en: While she was reading, the telephone rang.
cards.cn: 她正在看书的时候，电话响了。

cards.en: He was walking home when it began to rain.
cards.cn: 他正走回家的时候开始下雨了。

cards.en: When I arrived, the film had already begun.
cards.cn: 我到的时候，电影已经开始了。

cards.en: He had finished his homework before dinner.
cards.cn: 晚饭前他就做完了作业。

cards.en: She had never seen the sea before that trip.
cards.cn: 那次旅行之前她从未见过海。

cards.en: By last year, they had lived there for ten years.
cards.cn: 到去年为止，他们已经在那里住了十年。

cards.en: The man who is standing there is my uncle.
cards.cn: 站在那里的那个人是我叔叔。

cards.en: This is the book which I bought yesterday.
cards.cn: 这就是我昨天买的那本书。

cards.en: Do you know the girl who is singing?
cards.cn: 你认识那个正在唱歌的女孩吗？

cards.en: She is the teacher whose class we all like.
cards.cn: 她就是那位我们都喜欢她课的老师。

cards.en: Have you ever been to a place which is very quiet?
cards.cn: 你去过很安静的地方吗？

cards.en: I went to a small town which is near the sea.
cards.cn: 我去过一个靠海的小镇。

cards.en: The people who live there are very friendly.
cards.cn: 住在那里的人非常友好。

cards.en: It's a trip that I will never forget.
cards.cn: 那是一次我永远不会忘记的旅行。

cards.en: I want to learn English well.
It's not easy to remember so many words.
cards.cn: 记住这么多单词不容易。

cards.en: She has nothing to do this afternoon.
cards.cn: 她今天下午没什么事可做。

cards.en: She is a famous actress who lives in Paris.
cards.cn: 她是一位住在巴黎的著名女演员。

cards.en: Everyone wants to see her new film.
cards.cn: 大家都想看她的新电影。

cards.en: Her husband, who is a writer, is also well known.
cards.cn: 她的丈夫是位作家，也很有名。

cards.en: They have a house which is over a hundred years old.
cards.cn: 他们有一栋一百多年的房子。

cards.en: He drives at seventy miles an hour.
That's too fast. He must be mad.
He can't be a careful driver.
cards.cn: 他不可能是个细心的司机。

cards.en: He may be right, but I don't think so.
cards.cn: 他也许是对的，但我认为不是。

cards.en: It must be very late now.
She can't be at home. The lights are off.
cards.cn: 她不可能在家，灯是关着的。

cards.en: The report has been sent to the police.
Everybody was surprised by the story.
cards.cn: 所有人都对这个故事感到惊讶。

cards.en: It is said that he will leave the city.
cards.cn: 据说他将离开这座城市。

cards.en: The latest report says the weather will change.
It has been raining since last night.
cards.cn: 从昨晚开始一直在下雨。

cards.en: We were watching television when the lights went out.
cards.cn: 灯灭的时候我们正在看电视。

cards.en: I hope tomorrow will be fine.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
cards.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

cards.en: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
cards.cn: 如果你努力，就能通过考试。

cards.en: If I had more time, I would read more books.
cards.cn: 如果我有更多时间，我会读更多书。

cards.en: I'll call you if I need help.
cards.cn: 如果我需要帮助就给你打电话。

cards.en: He says that he is very busy today.
She asked me if I liked the film.
cards.cn: 她问我喜不喜欢那部电影。

cards.en: I don't know whether he will come.
Do you think that this is a good idea?
cards.cn: 你认为这是个好主意吗？

cards.en: The windows are cleaned every week.
English is spoken in many countries.
The letter was written by my grandfather.
A new school will be opened next year.
cards.cn: 一所新学校明年将开办。

cards.en: The trees in the park have been planted by students.
cards.cn: 公园里的树是学生们种的。

cards.en: These photos were taken in the mountains.
cards.cn: 这些照片是在山里拍的。

cards.en: The work must be finished before Friday.
cards.cn: 这项工作必须在周五前完成。
